items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: she gave me the entire Tarzan series by Edgar Rice Burroughs.

ctx.x: And, uh, and one of the things that, that she did, and I didn't realize it until I spoke to her about it later, was she gave me the entire Tarzan series by Edgar Rice Burroughs. Yeah, yeah. And it wasn't that she was interested in Tarzan, but she knew that Edgar Rice Burroughs was a, a good writer. Uh-huh. In other words, he, he, he wrote with good style and, and, and, and all those kinds of things. Yeah. So without me knowing it, I was learning the English language, enjoying reading the Tarzan series. Uh-huh.…
You heard, you heard, heard a lot of French and Spanish? Yeah. Uh-huh.
